title: Not sure if they are even safe to use.
text:
Not sure if they are even safe to use.. These bowls are plastic with a painted interior that has blisters in the paint. Not sure if they are even safe to use. There are no markings to indicate they are micro-wave safe. They can only safely hold 3/4 cup of liquid.

Update: I tried to use in the microwave and it ruined the inside of the bowl.

description: This is a pretty lacquer bowl with bright red color on inside surface and a black color on out side surface. The lacquer soup bowls are widely used in Japan. They can be used as rice bowls as well. Lacquer dinnerware was originated in China and has seven thousand years history.
